summary: Split 3a: queue world-anchored overlays and replay them after the composite
author: pm
body:
Names (`render_helpers.cpp`), chat bubbles (`CGame::draw_character_body`), damage numbers (`floating_text.draw_all`) and foe icons are queued during the world pass and replayed in screen space above the world, including above the late world effects (user decision).

**Done when:** overlays stay attached to sprites while moving and draw above all world effects; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.
